meta.definition: ChainHash-128 v3: GCM field GF(2^128), eight interleaved comb blocks of 512 bytes per 4 KiB region, raw 256-bit CLNH accumulators, Horner in an independent y with the byte length leading, integer twist plus quintic finalizer
meta.key_model: Model A 128 random bytes (s, y, c0..c4, tau); paper model 624 bytes (W+7 words, W=32)

registrations.chainhash128-v3: public entry point chainhash128_v3(): 512-byte blocks, runtime dispatch, product method per the selection rule

protocol.bulk: Average of alignments 0..7 at fixed 262144 bytes (SMHasher3 Average line)
protocol.small: Average of the 31 separately measured 1..31-byte costs
protocol.xeon: two complete passes; higher fixed-size bulk and lower small average selected independently
protocol.m2: three complete passes; median of bulk and median of small, independently; any run deviating more than 15 percent from its median is flagged, never dropped

meta.clock_caveat: Xeon B/TSC; M2 calibrated estimated cycles, not a privileged hardware cycle counter. Printed GiB/sec assumes 3.5 GHz.

default_selection.rule: chainhash128_v3() dispatches schoolbook products on XMM, ZMM and NEON; Karatsuba on YMM and portable. Both products give the same digest; the choice only affects speed.
